problem.passage:
In the figure, lines $m$ and $n$ are parallel. Lines $k$ and $j$ are two transversals that intersect each other at point $E$, which lies below line $n$. Line $k$ crosses line $m$ at point $A$ and line $n$ at point $B$. Line $j$ crosses line $m$ at point $C$ and line $n$ at point $D$. Triangle $BDE$ is formed by segments $BE$, $DE$, and $BD$ (the part of line $n$ between $B$ and $D$). At point $A$, the angle between ray $AC$ (along line $m$, toward $C$) and ray $AB$ (along line $k$, toward $B$) measures $52^\circ$. At point $C$, the angle between ray $CA$ (along line $m$, toward $A$) and ray $CD$ (along line $j$, toward $D$) measures $65^\circ$.

What is the measure, in degrees, of angle $BED$, the angle formed at point $E$ between transversals $k$ and $j$?
problem.stimulus: In the figure, lines $m$ and $n$ are parallel. Lines $k$ and $j$ are two transversals that intersect each other at point $E$, which lies below line $n$. Line $k$ crosses line $m$ at point $A$ and line $n$ at point $B$. Line $j$ crosses line $m$ at point $C$ and line $n$ at point $D$. Triangle $BDE$ is formed by segments $BE$, $DE$, and $BD$ (the part of line $n$ between $B$ and $D$). At point $A$, the angle between ray $AC$ (along line $m$, toward $C$) and ray $AB$ (along line $k$, toward $B$) measures $52^\circ$. At point $C$, the angle between ray $CA$ (along line $m$, toward $A$) and ray $CD$ (along line $j$, toward $D$) measures $65^\circ$.
problem.question: What is the measure, in degrees, of angle $BED$, the angle formed at point $E$ between transversals $k$ and $j$?
problem.explanation:
Since lines $m$ and $n$ are parallel and line $k$ is a transversal, the angle at $A$ (52°) and the angle at $B$ between line $n$ and line $k$ on the corresponding side are related by the co-interior (same-side interior) angle relationship: the angle $ABD$ (interior angle at $B$ on the side of $D$) equals 180° − 52° = 128°... 

More directly: Since $m \parallel n$, angle $A$ (52°, between $AC$ and $AB$) and angle $ABE$ (between $BA$ and $BD$, on the same side) are co-interior angles with respect to transversal $k$, so angle $ABD = 180° - 52° = 128°$, giving angle $ABE = 180° - 128° = 52°$ (angle $ABE$ is vertical/supplementary depending on configuration — using alternate interior angles instead): angle $ABE$ (formed between line $k$ and line $n$, on the E side) is equal to angle $A$'s alternate interior angle, so angle $ABE = 52°$ is NOT correct since E is below n, so angle between BE and BD equals the alternate interior angle to angle $A$, giving angle $EBD = 52°$... 

Using the standard result: angle $EBD = 52°$ (alternate interior angle with angle $A$) and angle $EDB = 65°$ (alternate interior angle with angle $C$). In triangle $BDE$, the angles sum to $180°$, so angle $BED = 180° - 52° - 65° = 63°$.

The correct answer is 63° (index 0). A student who forgets to use the triangle angle sum and instead just adds the two given angles would get 117° (choice D), missing the key relationship that the third angle of the triangle must make all three sum to 180°.

difficultyReasons: 평행선 성질(동위각)을 두 번 적용해 삼각형의 두 내각을 구해야 함(2단계)
구한 두 각을 삼각형 내각의 합 180°에서 빼는 계산이 추가로 필요함(3단계)
오답들이 정답 계산 과정의 중간값(52, 65, 117)과 정확히 일치하여 변별력이 높음
도형 해석(어느 각이 동위각/엇각인지 파악)이 필요함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 52°는 각 B의 측정값과 동일해서, 엇각/대응각 개념을 잘못 적용하면 각 E도 52°라고 착각할 수 있다.
distractors.matches: 각 A(=52°)와 각 B가 평행선의 동위각 관계임을 착각하여 그대로 E에 적용
distractors.whyWrong: 각 B는 각 A의 동위각으로 52°가 맞지만, 삼각형 내각합을 이용해 E를 구해야 하며 E=52°가 아니라 63°이다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 65°는 각 D와 같은 값이라 각 C(65°)와 각 D가 엇각 관계라는 것을 알면서도 삼각형 각도 합을 적용하지 않고 그대로 답으로 착각할 수 있다
distractors.matches: 각 C=65°가 평행선 성질로 각 D=65°가 됨을 이용한 값과 동일
distractors.whyWrong: 각 D=65°는 맞지만 이는 삼각형의 한 내각일 뿐이며, E를 구하려면 180-52-65=63°를 계산해야 한다

distractors.plausibleBecause: 52+65=117이라는 계산을 하고 이를 그대로 답으로 착각하거나, 외각 정리를 잘못 적용해 삼각형 외각이 두 내각의 합이라는 사실을 엉뚱한 각에 적용할 수 있다
distractors.matches: 52+65의 합 계산 과정이 실제 풀이 중간 단계(180-63=117)와 유사하게 보임
distractors.whyWrong: 117°는 두 내각의 합이며 이는 외각의 크기(즉 E의 보각)일 뿐, 내각 E 자체는 180-117=63°이다
